parameters.name: CertifyId
parameters.description: The unique identity of the ID Verification request.

parameters.name: Crop
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to allow trim of the face image. Valid values:

- T: Trim is allowed.

- F (default): Trim is not allowed.

parameters.name: DeviceToken
parameters.description: The device token, which is used for risk identification.

parameters.name: FaceContrastPicture
parameters.description: The Base64 encoding of the photo.

parameters.name: Ip
parameters.description: The IP address of the user network.

parameters.name: Mobile
parameters.description: The mobile phone number of the user.

parameters.name: OssBucketName
parameters.description: The bucket name of the authorization-granted OSS bucket.

parameters.name: OssObjectName
parameters.description: The file name in the authorization-granted OSS bucket.

parameters.name: OuterOrderNo
parameters.description: The custom business unique identity on the client side, which is used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can contain up to 32 alphanumeric characters. Make sure the value is unique.

parameters.name: SceneId
parameters.description: The ID of the authentication scenario. This ID is automatically generated after you create an authentication scenario in the console.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The custom user ID (up to 100 characters). Make sure the value is unique.
